prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent presentation UI sprite for a bottom progress track, displayed very small and vertically
Primary request: create a cinematic black monolith image to replace a crude empty CSS rectangle in a Kubrick-inspired presentation
Scene/backdrop: isolated object only on a genuinely transparent background
Subject: a single upright rectangular monolith with exact severe 1:4:9 proportions, perfectly flat top, subtly beveled razor-sharp edges, monumental even at tiny scale
Style/medium: photorealistic practical miniature photographed for a late-1960s prestige science-fiction film, austere and geometrically perfect
Composition/framing: strict frontal three-quarter view with only a slight visible side plane; full slab centered with generous transparent clearance, no cropping
Lighting/mood: hard warm-white rim light grazing the left and top edges, faint cool reflected light on one face so the volume reads against black; ominous, silent, minimal
Color palette: near-black obsidian with warm-white edge light, no other colors
Materials/textures: dense matte stone-black surface with extremely subtle fine texture, not glossy
Constraints: transparent alpha background; no ground, shadows beyond the object, stars, planets, scenery, people, text, logos, border, bloom, aura, watermark; must remain unmistakably solid when reduced to about 12 by 34 CSS pixels
